service: Free Seeds, Seedlings, Fertilizers, and Fingerlings
description: The Office of the Provincial Agriculturist provides free agricultural inputs to qualified farmers and fisherfolk in Aklan, including seeds, seedlings, fertilizers, and fingerlings.
steps: Go to the Office of the Provincial Agriculturist at the Provincial Capitol, Kalibo, or contact your Municipal Agriculture Office.
Present your Farm Household ID or proof of residency and farming activity.
Submit a request/application for the specific input needed (seeds, fertilizer, fingerlings).
Claim the agricultural inputs on the scheduled distribution date.
requirements: Farm Household ID (if registered with RSBSA/PhilSys)
Proof of farming/fishing activity (land title, lease, or barangay certification)

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Registered farmers and fisherfolk in Aklan
quickInfo.processingTime: Subject to availability and distribution schedule

description: The Office of the Provincial Veterinarian provides free or subsidized veterinary care, vaccination, and deworming services for livestock and farm animals in Aklan.
steps: Contact the Office of the Provincial Veterinarian or your Municipal Agriculture Office.
Register your livestock for the provincial vaccination/deworming program.
Await the scheduled visit by provincial veterinary team to your barangay.
For emergency veterinary cases, bring the animal to the nearest municipal agriculture office.

description: Training programs for modern farming and fishing techniques offered through the Office of the Provincial Agriculturist and the Aklan Agri-Aqua Demonstration Farms and Training Center.
steps: Monitor announcements from the Office of the Provincial Agriculturist on the official Aklan website and Facebook page.
Register for the training program at the Provincial Agriculturist's Office or via your Municipal Agriculture Office.
Attend training sessions at the Aklan Agri-Aqua Demonstration Farms and Training Center or designated venue.
